stars_field: Annual potable water use
rationale: Both describe water consumed by the organization.
caveat: DEFINITIONS DIFFER. GRI 303-5 water consumption = withdrawal minus discharge. STARS 'annual potable water use' is potable supply only and is not computed that way. Do not present this as GRI 303-5 without recomputing.
claude_note: REJECT. 'Annual potable water use' is byte-identical to 'Total water withdrawal' for all three universities (TUD 56,570 / Cork 54,153 / Berkeley 2,092,006) — it IS withdrawal, already mapped at line 27. GRI 303-5 defines consumption as withdrawal MINUS discharge. Berkeley returns 107,386 m3, so its true 303-5 figure is 1,984,620, not 2,092,006. Publishing this mapping overstates Berkeley's water consumption by 5.4%. 303-5 must be DERIVED, not mapped to this field.

stars_field: Annual volume of water recovered and/or returned
rationale: Water returned to the environment is conceptually adjacent to GRI 303-4 water discharge.
caveat: GRI 303-4 requires discharge by destination, freshwater/other water split, and treatment level. STARS captures none of that. Weak mapping - verify before use.
claude_note: REJECT as a 303-4 mapping. 'Recovered and/or returned' is not GRI's 'water discharge': recovered water may be reused on site and never discharged at all. GRI 303-4 also requires destination, freshwater/other split and treatment level, none of which STARS collects. Keep the FIELD though — it is the subtrahend needed to derive 303-5 (see line 30).
